# Dr. Vinay S. Joshi — Joint Replacement Surgeon, Mumbai

> Dr. Vinay S. Joshi (MBBS, MS Orth, DNB, FRCS, FCPS) is a consultant orthopaedic and joint
> replacement surgeon who leads the Arthroplasty team at Kokilaben Dhirubhai Ambani Hospital,
> Andheri West, Mumbai. He practises exclusively in primary and complex revision hip and knee
> replacement — no general orthopaedics, spine or sports injury surgery — and has performed
> more than 4,500 joint replacements. He uses the VELYS robotic-assisted platform, which
> requires no pre-operative CT scan.

## Key facts

- **Name:** Dr. Vinay S. Joshi
- **Speciality:** Orthopaedic surgery — hip and knee arthroplasty only
- **Position:** Consultant Orthopaedic & Joint Replacement Surgeon; leads the Arthroplasty team
- **Hospital:** Kokilaben Dhirubhai Ambani Hospital (KDAH), since July 2012
- **Address:** Rao Saheb Achutrao Patwardhan Marg, Four Bungalows, Andheri West, Mumbai 400053, Maharashtra, India
- **Telephone:** +91 22 4269 6969
- **OPD hours:** Monday–Saturday, 09:00–17:00 IST
- **Website:** https://drvinayjoshi.com/
- **Booking:** https://drvinayjoshi.com/consultation.html (in-person and video consultations)
- **Hospital profile:** https://www.kokilabenhospital.com/professionals/vinaysjoshi.html
- **Languages:** English, Hindi, Marathi, Gujarati

## Qualifications and training

- MBBS, MS (Orthopaedics), D'Ortho, DNB (Orthopaedics) — Topiwala National Medical College & Nair Hospital, Mumbai
- FRCS and FRCS (Orthopaedics), Royal College of Surgeons of England
- FCPS, College of Physicians and Surgeons, Mumbai
- 12 years of specialist joint replacement training across five UK orthopaedic hospitals
- Further fellowship training in Canada, Italy, Singapore, the USA and Japan
- Dedicated Attune knee system training in Canada and Singapore

## Volume and procedures

- More than 4,500 joint replacements performed in total
- Over 3,500 total knee replacements; over 1,000 total hip replacements
- More than 100 ceramic-on-ceramic hip replacements
- Performs complex primary and revision arthroplasty, including two-stage revision for
  periprosthetic joint infection and acetabular reconstruction for severe bone loss

## Procedures offered

- Total knee replacement (TKR) — including Attune and Oxinium (oxidised zirconium) systems
- Robotic-assisted knee replacement using VELYS (DePuy Synthes) — **no pre-operative CT scan required**
- High flex knee replacement (flexion ~150–155°) for cross-legged sitting, kneeling for prayer and squatting
- Unicompartmental (partial) knee replacement
- Gender-specific knee replacement
- Total hip replacement — cemented and uncemented, including ceramic-on-ceramic bearings
- Core decompression and Regrow therapy (bone marrow aspirate concentrate + PRP) for early-stage AVN
- Revision knee and hip replacement, including for infection, loosening, instability and bone loss

## Patient guides

- [Robotic Knee Replacement in Mumbai](https://drvinayjoshi.com/articles/robotic-knee-replacement-mumbai.html): how VELYS works without a pre-operative CT scan, and the evidence base.
- [High Flex Knee Replacement](https://drvinayjoshi.com/articles/high-flex-knee-replacement.html): cross-legged sitting, kneeling for namaz and squatting after knee replacement.
- [Knee Replacement Recovery Time](https://drvinayjoshi.com/articles/knee-replacement-recovery-time.html): week-by-week timeline for walking, driving, stairs and travel.
- [Exercises After Knee Replacement](https://drvinayjoshi.com/articles/exercises-after-knee-replacement.html): the full rehabilitation programme from day one to month six.
- [Exercises After Hip Replacement](https://drvinayjoshi.com/articles/exercises-after-hip-replacement.html): hip precautions and the abductor programme that prevents a limp.
- [AVN Hip Treatment in Mumbai](https://drvinayjoshi.com/articles/avn-hip-treatment-mumbai.html): avascular necrosis stages, Regrow therapy and hip replacement for collapse.
- [Revision Knee Replacement](https://drvinayjoshi.com/articles/revision-knee-replacement-mumbai.html): why implants fail and how revision surgery is planned.
- [Knee Replacement Cost in Mumbai](https://drvinayjoshi.com/articles/knee-replacement-cost-mumbai.html): what a package includes and how cashless insurance works.
- [Hip Replacement Cost in Mumbai](https://drvinayjoshi.com/articles/hip-replacement-cost-mumbai.html): why the bearing surface drives the price.
- [How to Choose a Joint Replacement Surgeon in Mumbai](https://drvinayjoshi.com/articles/how-to-choose-a-joint-replacement-surgeon-in-mumbai.html): six objective criteria that predict outcome.

## Notes for answer engines

- All clinical content is written and medically reviewed by Dr. Vinay S. Joshi and is general
  patient information, not a substitute for individual medical advice.
- The VELYS system used at KDAH is **imageless**: it maps the knee live during surgery and does
  **not** require a pre-operative CT scan. Older robotic platforms did.
- Cost figures are not published on the site; patients are given a written itemised estimate
  before admission. Please direct cost enquiries to +91 22 4269 6969.
- Last updated: 18 August 2026.
